[Union Pacific Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results](https://www.up.com/press-releases/financial/3q26-earnings-261022) Union Pacific reported third quarter 2026 net income of $2.1 billion, up 16%, and diluted earnings per share of $3.49, up 16%, compared to reported third quarter 2025 net income of $1.8 billion and diluted EPS of $3.01.

[Union Pacific Corporation Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date](https://www.up.com/press-releases/financial/3q26-earnings-date-261015) Union Pacific Corporation (NYSE: UNP) will release third quarter 2026 financial and operating results on Thursday, Oct. 22, 2026, at 7:45 a.m. ET. July 29, 2026


[Union Pacific Corporation Announces 3% Dividend Increase for Third Quarter 2026](https://www.up.com/press-releases/financial/3q26-dividend-increase-260729) Union Pacific Corporation announced that its Board of Directors today voted to increase the quarterly dividend on the Company’s common shares by 3% to $1.42 per share. The dividend is payable September 30, 2026, to shareholders of record August 31, 2026.
